An '''infrared receptor'''<ref name="RB" /> or '''infrared scanner'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]].<ref name="RB" /> [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droids]] such as the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]], [[R5-series astromech droid|R5]], and [[R6-series astromech droid|R6-series]] models were equipped with infrared receptors.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] [[R2-D0]] was equipped with an infrared receptor.<ref name="RB" /> 

The [[Macrobinocular viewplate/Legends|macrobinocular viewplate]] on [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] incorporated an infrared receptor.<ref name="EssentialArmor">{{StoryCite|story=Boba Fett's Armor: An Essential Guide to a Walking Weapon|book=Star Wars: Boba Fett}}</ref>
